title: How the Ad Auction Works
objectives: Understand the Total Auction Value formula
Discover why higher ad quality lowers your advertising costs
Learn why the biggest bank account doesn't always win on Meta

blocks.text: Every time an Instagram user opens their feed, Meta runs an auction in 1/100th of a second!
Who wins that feed slot? Not just the person willing to pay the most money. Meta protects its users from boring, spammy ads.

blocks.title: The Total Value Formula
blocks.text: Total Value = (Bid Amount) × (Estimated Action Rate) + (Ad Quality & Relevance Score). If your creative is beloved by users, your required bid drops dramatically!

left.title: Brand A (Boring Ad)
points: Total Value: Low → Costs stay very high

right.title: Brand B (Engaging Ad)
points: Total Value: High → Meta rewards with cheap CPM!

blocks.text: You can beat giant corporate competitors with deep pockets simply by having a better, more relatable ad creative.
Misleading hooks, sensational health claims, or hiding prices will tank your Ad Quality score and inflate costs.

quiz.q: What is the core formula Meta uses to determine who wins the ad auction?
options: Total Value = Bid × Estimated Action Rate + Ad Quality
quiz.hint: Remember the 3 factors: money, predicted user action, and user experience score.
quiz.explain: Meta multiplies your bid by the likelihood of action, plus the quality score of your creative.

quiz.q: How can a small local business with a ₹500/day budget beat a large brand in the auction?
options: By creating high-engagement ads with high relevance and click-through rates
By posting ads only at 3:00 AM
quiz.hint: High ad quality and predicted actions lower the required monetary bid.
quiz.explain: High creative relevance earns lower CPMs, allowing smaller budgets to win high-value impressions.

quiz.q: True or False: Using clickbait headlines like 'You won't believe this shocking secret!' improves your ad quality score.
quiz.hint: Does Meta like sensational clickbait that frustrates users?
quiz.explain: False. Meta actively penalizes clickbait and withheld information, increasing your advertising costs.

quiz.q: What does 'Estimated Action Rate' represent in the auction?
options: How fast your website server loads
Meta's prediction of how likely this specific user is to complete your campaign goal
The number of emojis in your caption
The battery life of the user's phone
quiz.hint: Prediction based on past behavior of the person viewing the ad.
quiz.explain: Meta predicts whether a user is genuinely interested in your type of offer before placing the ad.

recap: Total Auction Value balances Bid, Estimated Action Rate, and Ad Quality.
A better creative directly lowers your acquisition costs in the auction.
